Cerberax.habitat:
You can find Cerberax on The Center, Scorched Earth, Lost Colony, Ragnarok, Extinction, Valguero, Astraeos and Genesis.

Reported places to start looking (latitude, longitude):

Valguero: search the northern area around 41, 15.

Ragnarok: try the main desert around 58, 77. Another reported desert sighting is near 50, 76.5; snowy regions are also worth searching.

The Center: search the northern island; the reported area is spread out rather than a single point.

Extinction: try the northern area around 22, 53.

Scorched Earth: look east of the scar, around 51, 28.

Astraeos: search across Therokis, the dark Extinction-themed island.

Gargantar.habitat:
You can find Gargantar on The Center, Scorched Earth, Lost Colony, Ragnarok, Extinction, Valguero and Astraeos.

Reported places to start looking (latitude, longitude):

Valguero: try around 53, 13 and 41, 13.

Ragnarok: look around 23, 58 and farther east around 22, 64.

The Center: search the northern area around 14, 52 and 14, 61.

Extinction: reported search points are 19, 15; 87, 28; and 85, 41.

Scorched Earth: search the scar around 51, 17.

Astraeos: search around Therokis, the dark Extinction-themed island. Five spawn areas were reported, but exact points weren’t supplied.
